name: ESO 060-IG016 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 060-IG016, a luminous infrared galaxy merger, seen by Hubble.
label: eso060ig016-hubble
story: Galaxies like this one are interacting or merging disks whose collisions stir up bursts of star formation, and here an active nucleus likely makes a large contribution as well.

claims.text: ESO 060-IG016 is a luminous infrared galaxy in the GOALS sample (target of the ACS LIRG survey)
ESO 060-IG016 likely has a large AGN contribution
Targets of program 10592 are luminous infrared galaxies, primarily interacting or merging disk galaxies with enhanced star formation and AGN activity
